title: Acute airway eosinophilic inflammation model in mice induced by ovalbumin, house dust mite, or shrimp tropomyosin: a comparative study
author: Liangyu Xu
license_note: figshare article detail endpoint license.name: CC BY 4.0

steps.title: Prepare allergen‑adjuvant mixtures
steps.instruction: Mix each allergen (ovalbumin, house dust mite extract, or shrimp tropomyosin) with aluminum hydroxide [Al(OH)3] to create the sensitization formulation.

steps.title: Sensitize mice via intraperitoneal injections
steps.instruction: Administer three separate intraperitoneal (i.p.) injections of the chosen allergen‑Al(OH)3 mixture to each C57BL/6J mouse.

steps.title: Perform single intratracheal challenge
steps.instruction: After the sensitization series, deliver one intratracheal (i.t.) dose of the same allergen to each mouse.

steps.title: Collect samples for analysis
steps.instruction: Harvest bronchoalveolar lavage (BAL) fluid, lung tissue, and blood plasma from each mouse for downstream assessments.

substeps.instruction: Count total cells and eosinophils in BAL fluid.
Extract RNA from lung tissue for transcriptomic (RNA‑seq) and qRT‑PCR analysis of cytokine/chemokine mRNAs (e.g., Il‑4, Il‑5, Il‑13, Ccl‑11, Ccl‑24, Ccl‑17, Cxcl‑1).
Perform histopathology to evaluate lung‑to‑body weight ratio, eosinophil infiltration, and mucus hypersecretion.
